title: Lost passport
when: Your passport is lost or stolen.

steps.text: Stay calm and go to a safe place. Tap SOS now to reach a person.
Tell the local police and get a written report. Police number: {{current.emergency.police}}.
Keep a photo of your passport page if you saved one. Your trip reference is {{booking.ref}}.
Tell your hotel {{current.hotel.name}} and your airline.

ask.question: Is your flight in the next 3 days?

steps.text: Ask the consulate for an emergency travel document as soon as it opens. Give your flight date.
Our team can help move your flight. Tap SOS to start.
Ask the consulate about the steps and the fee. Keep the police report with you.
